title: THE INFINITE ABYSS
description: A survival, horror, and adventure Minecraft modpack.
body:
This modpack focuses on exploration, survival, and adventure, with additional horror-themed content.

It includes multiple dimensions, new structures, biomes, creatures, and progression paths to discover throughout gameplay. Players can gather resources, upgrade equipment, build bases, and explore different environments while facing a variety of challenges.

The modpack also contains horror-related mods that may introduce unexpected encounters and atmospheric moments during exploration.

It can be played in both single-player and multiplayer. Players may choose to explore alone or cooperate with others to gather resources, build settlements, and progress through the available content.

The goal of this modpack is to provide a combination of exploration, survival, adventure, and horror content using a curated selection of mods.
